description:
"My twin sister, who abandoned me twenty years ago, returned with a perfect life". Mi-Jeong, a single mother, works as a cleaner. Her sister became a successful artist. Mi-Jeong begins to desire her sister's life.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=839509), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12659838)
